features.name: Okeeheelee Playground
features.description: Okeeheelee Playground is the park's main sand-surface family play area, with separate play structures listed for ages 2-5 and 5-12, shade trees, nearby picnic space, and activity-area parking and restrooms.
features.source_label: Palm Beach County Parks and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Palm Beach County Parks and Recreation

features.name: Okeeheelee Canoe and Kayak Area
features.description: Okeeheelee Canoe and Kayak Area is the central freshwater-lake launch and rental zone for non-motorized paddling, with a mapped boat ramp, nearby parking, restrooms, picnic areas, and a separately operated rental concession.
features.source_label: Palm Beach County Parks and Recreation

features.name: Okeeheelee Nature Center
features.description: Okeeheelee Nature Center is a free visitor and environmental-education destination inside Okeeheelee Park, with hands-on ecosystem exhibits, live animal ambassadors, a preschool Discovery Zone, a wildlife-viewing window, and 2.5 miles of trails through 90 acres of pine flatwoods and wetlands.
features.source_label: Palm Beach County Parks and Recreation

features.name: Okeeheelee Disc Golf Course
features.description: Okeeheelee Disc Golf Course is the park's 18-hole public course, laid out around the Pooch Pines activity area with open fairways, mature trees, paved park paths, lakes, and water-edge holes.
features.source_label: Palm Beach County Parks and Recreation

features.name: Okeeheelee Golf Course
features.description: Okeeheelee Golf Course is Palm Beach County's 27-hole public golf facility, arranged as three nine-hole courses with a driving range, practice areas, Golf Shop, and Okee Grill on a lake-and-palm landscape inside Okeeheelee Park.
